title: no_trainer_alert
description: The facts the message kind no_trainer_alert (urgent: a private request came from a ZIP no active region holds) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: No trainer for a request (urgent)
triggers: A private request is saved from a ZIP that no active region holds (registration_service.register, outcome created): sent automatically to every active super admin, admin and Global Inspector, and to anyone holding a state-level grant for that ZIP's state.
An edit through the completion link turns a request urgent (a new ZIP that no active region holds): sent again, once for that edit. An edit that leaves it urgent does not send it again.
x_kind.recipient: adhoc: the Google email and name on each access person told. The staff audience gets the requester's details; the inspector audience (a Global Inspector, who is view only and never sees private data) gets the town and state only.
x_kind.dedupe: explicit key: kind + request id + access person id + the stamp of the event (the request's creation time, or the edit's time), so a retry never doubles a notice and a later edit that turns it urgent again is still told

name.description: How the email greets the person: the first word of their name, else the word there.

who.description: Who the subject line names: the requester's full name in the staff copy, the words a request in the Inspector's copy (who never sees a name).

town.description: The town of the requester's ZIP, from the ZIP table. Public place information, safe for the Inspector's copy.

state_code.description: The two-letter state of the requester's ZIP.

console_url.description: The address of the Console. Public; never carries a key or a token.

requester_name.description: The requester's full name. Staff copy only; never in the Inspector's copy.

requester_email.description: The requester's email address. Staff copy only.

requester_phone.description: The requester's phone number, when they gave one. Staff copy only.

postal_code.description: The ZIP the requester gave. Staff copy only.

confirmation_number.description: The confirmation number of the request. Staff copy only.

reason.description: Why this notice went out now: a new request, or a request whose ZIP changed to one no active region holds.
examples: A new request just came in.
